points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source clean-builds in isolated network-disabled cfd-bench; CTest registers no tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Case/output/restart and control overrides in main.cpp; no production solver rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case, mesh, partition, solver and output files; fixed 2-D state remains.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper found in source; external similarity investigation excluded under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: CGNS mesh/case/BC paths are case-configured; unsupported CGNS MIXED elements are not parsed.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:42–60 root-only global mesh, METIS partitions and local/ghost exchanges; submitted rank-study executable hashes unbound.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity and finite checks exist, but output.cpp:272–291 ignores fread return values for restart payloads.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight output packages passed validator; isolated build succeeds, no registered CTests and no unsteady rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Documented code, scripts and original 66-figure manifest; data live in workspace and metadata revision is stale.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
